text.p: HOSPODARSKE NOVINY - Budget revenues from tax and custom duty payments should be higher in 1997 by some 10 billion crowns against the previous year.
- Tax and custom payments in the first three months of 1997 exceeded the amount planned for the period by around two billion crowns.
- The overall amount of tax and custom duty evasions decreased by some 6.3 billion crowns in 1996 and totalled 23.4 billion crowns at the end of the year.

- OZ KOVO, the largest trade union representing engineering sector employees, said it would oppose this year's general agreement with the government until new laws adjust the tax system in accordance with an increase in costs of living.
- Production in the textile and clothing industry decreased by 1.1 percent, year-on-year, in 1997.

NARODNA OBRODA - Slovakia's engineering sector recorded a 20 percent increase in production in 1997 over the previous year. The main factor behind the increase was car production in Volkswagen's Bratislava plant.

- Slovakia's third largest commercial bank, Polnobanka a.s., posted a 1996 profit of 162.7 million crowns. It did not say whether this figure was net or gross. Polnobanka's balance sum increased by 35 percent year-on-year and totalled 29.1 billion crowns.

SME - The paper quotes a collaborator of the Slovak secret service, the SIS, as saying the SIS has carried out activities aimed to discredit President Michal Kovac including the kidnapping of his son in September 1995.
- Finance Minister Sergej Kozlik said the planned Slovak- Russian gas joint-venture could help Slovakia to become more important corridor for the transfer of Russian gas to western consumers.
